report:
KEY kit is finished. The shared games kit, the games lobby and catalogue, the game details page and Pool Dice are built and checked against a running API, using a production build plus my own API instance on port 4212. All of it uses DEMO credits only. They are labelled "DEMO credits · no cash value" on every surface, every bet panel shows "Fees 0.00" and "You can lose your stake", and nothing touches USDT. The e2e test checks that the USDT wallet balances are unchanged after play, and that the server refuses a bet with currency USDT (403 REAL_MONEY_DISABLED).

**What I built**
- Data layer: `/home/user/Claude/global-pool/apps/web/src/lib/api/games.ts`. Wrappers over `apiRequest()` with TanStack hooks for:
  - the catalogue and one game;
  - DEMO credits and reset;
  - seeds, rotate and change client seed;
  - placing bets (the caller owns the idempotency key);
  - bet history and the verify bundle.
  - It also has `applySettledBet`, `playInfoOf` and `classifyGameError`, which turns any API error into a UI state.
- Games kit: `/home/user/Claude/global-pool/apps/web/src/components/games/kit/*` (barrel `index.ts`).
  - `GameLayout` is the whole game screen in the casino style with the collapsed sidebar. It holds the header, the [bet panel | stage] card, the GM-01 session bar, the lower columns, the licence line and the mobile sticky bet bar. Blocking states sit over a dimmed, inert stage.
  - `useGameGate` mirrors the server's gaming policy: guest, onboarding, region, self-excluded, blocked, time limit, loss limit, offline.
  - `useBetRunner` uses one idempotency key per intent. After a network or 5xx failure it retries with the same key, so the server replays the stored result instead of charging twice. It holds the reality check while a bet is in flight.
  - Bet panel parts: `BetPanel` (Manual/Auto), `BetAmountField` (½ · 2× · Min · Max; Max never goes above the balance), `BeforeYouBet` (shows Fees 0.00 DEMO).
  - Auto-play: `AutoPlayPanel` + `useAutoPlay` with the pure rules in `autoplay.ts`. It needs a stop-loss and an unticked confirmation, keeps the stake constant, and stops at the stop-loss, profit target or count, on an error, on a reality check, or when the tab is hidden.
  - `DemoCreditsChip` (balance + reset dialog), `GameSessionBar` (normal / approaching / reached; popover on desktop, compact strip + bottom sheet on mobile), `SeedDisplay` + `SeedsDialog`.
  - `VerifyDrawer` re-derives the bet in the browser with `verifyBet()` from `@gp/shared/fair`. It has "Rotate seeds & reveal" for a still-secret seed, editable seeds that show the mismatch state, and HMAC block 0.
  - Also `BetHistory`, `RecentResults`, `ResultBanner`, `HowItWorksCard`, `MoreGamesRail`, `GameNotice` / `PromptCard` / `PanelNotice` / `GameSkeleton`, `MobileBetBar`, `useReducedMotion`, and `registry.ts` (play screens, routes, motion durations from `@gp/tokens`, fixed copy).
- Lobby: `components/games/lobby/*`.
  - `GamesLobby` (PUB-03 + GM-02): banner, category tabs with counts, debounced search, filter chips, sort, Global Pool spotlight with live round data, a DEMO-credits card, sections (grid; on mobile, originals as 2 columns + "Show all", other sections as swipe rails), filters bottom sheet, empty state that lists matches in other categories, restricted state with a dev preview at `?state=restricted`.
  - `GameDetails` (PUB-04): payout tables are computed with `@gp/shared/fair`, not typed by hand.
  - `tile-art.tsx`: concrete-object art for the 17 titles without existing art.
- Pool Dice: `components/games/dice/*`.
  - `dice-math.ts` uses integer hundredths and the server's own multiplier function.
  - `DiceSlider` is a keyboard slider: arrows ±1.00, Shift ±0.01, PageUp/PageDown ±10.00, Home/End to the limits.
  - `DiceStage`: the roll marker eases to the real result in 800 ms, and shows it instantly under reduced motion.
  - `DiceGame`: linked target / win chance / multiplier inputs, Space to roll, auto-play, verify, history, seeds, and every DI-07 state.
- Routes, all under `apps/web/src/app/(app)/games/`: `page.tsx`, `pool-dice/page.tsx`, `[slug]/page.tsx`, `[slug]/details/page.tsx`.
- Tests and QA:
  - `apps/web/test/games-kit.test.ts`: 21 unit tests.
  - `apps/web/e2e/games-kit.spec.ts`.
  - `apps/web/scripts/games-kit-qa.mjs`: 19 screens × 1440/390; fails on horizontal overflow or console errors.
- Docs: a "Games kit (P1)" section plus a lobby/details/dice subsection in `/home/user/Claude/global-pool/docs/WEB_COMPONENTS.md`.

**Shared files changed (additive)**
- `shell/shell-overrides.tsx` + `shell/app-shell.tsx`: a `collapseSidebar` override. The burger expands the sidebar for that visit only; the saved preference is not touched.
- `rg-history/reality-check.tsx`: `holdRealityCheck()` and `requestRealityCheck()`. The host does not open the reminder while a bet is in flight.
- `domain/game-tile.tsx`: new props `art`, `gradient` and `comingSoon`, and the `game` type now accepts any slug. This also fixes a latent crash: the account dashboard was passing slugs without art.
- `account/dashboard/sections.tsx`: I removed the one cast my type change made unnecessary, so lint stays green.

**Checks I ran**
- `pnpm --filter @gp/shared test`: PASS, 9 files, 138 tests.
- `pnpm --filter @gp/web typecheck`: PASS.
- `pnpm --filter @gp/web lint`: PASS.
- `pnpm --filter @gp/web test`: PASS, 11 files, 118 tests (21 of them mine).
- API: not touched, so its tests were not run.
- `flock /tmp/gp-web-build.lock env NEXT_DIST_DIR=.next-kit NEXT_PUBLIC_DATA_SOURCE=api NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:4212 NEXT_PUBLIC_STATE_PREVIEW=true pnpm --filter @gp/web build`: EXIT 0. Route sizes: `/games` 21.4 kB, `/games/pool-dice` 9.55 kB, plus `/games/[slug]` and `/games/[slug]/details`. The `sections.tsx` cast removal came after this build; it is a type-only change.
- `BASE_URL=http://localhost:3112 API_URL=http://localhost:4212 node scripts/games-kit-qa.mjs` against the production build: 38 screenshots in `apps/web/test-results/visual/games/kit/`, no overflow, no console errors.
- `E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3112 E2E_API_URL=http://localhost:4212 pnpm --filter @gp/web exec playwright test e2e/games-kit.spec.ts`: passed twice against the production build (8.6 s, 9.1 s) and once against dev. It covers:
  - lobby → Pool Dice tile;
  - DEMO label, Fees 0.00, "You can lose your stake";
  - slider keyboard;
  - auto-play confirmation unticked and Start disabled;
  - a roll with balance = 1,000.00 ± net, and the USDT wallet unchanged;
  - My rolls and the verify drawer (secret seed → rotate & reveal → verified in the browser → edited seed shows a mismatch → restore);
  - a dropped response replayed with the same key, giving exactly one bet;
  - 3 auto-play rolls, all with stake 10.00;
  - details page with Play (DEMO credits);
  - `/games/skyline` showing "Play screen coming soon";
  - 403 REAL_MONEY_DISABLED for a USDT bet.
- Figma: 3 screenshots (PUB-03 1440, GM-02 1440, PUB-03 390), saved in `/home/user/Claude/design/reference/games/`. I also used the engine agent's GM-03 and GM-05 renders. The DI and PUB-04 frames are not built in Figma, so I followed the prepared scripts in `pending/g-dice` and `pending/pub-04`.

**Deviations from the design**
1. Games show DEMO credits, not the USDT amounts in the frames (owner instruction).
2. Game pages use the collapsed sidebar. The DI scripts used the expanded one at 1440; the GM frames use collapsed.
3. Insufficient balance offers "Bet X instead" and "Reset DEMO credits" instead of "Deposit USDT", because DEMO credits cannot be bought.
4. Multipliers are truncated, so under 50.50 shows 1.9603× (Figma 1.9604×). Win chance reads 0.01–98% and Twenty-One's minimum bet reads 1.00, following the engine.
5. Left out because they would be invented data: the lobby's weekly tournament banner (replaced by a DEMO-credits card), the details page's "last 1,000 rolls" stats, and DI-05's all-player result histogram. DI-05 also has no CSV export button.
6. The region notice keeps the design's "please don't use a VPN or proxy" line, as the auth module does. It gives no bypass hints.
7. The details page also lives at `/games/<slug>/details`, because static play routes take priority over `/games/[slug]`.
8. The kit sends the RG activity heartbeat after a settled bet, at most once a minute, so the session starts with the first bet.

**Things to flag to other owners**
- The rg-history reality-check card shows the session's net result in USDT from the RG session, not in DEMO credits.
- `lib/fairness/dice.ts` (homepage and PUB-07 teaser) uses a different dice algorithm from `@gp/shared/fair`.
- In production, the sidebar prefetches `/vip` and `/winners`, which return 404 and stop Playwright's `networkidle` from settling. My QA script works around it.
- `apps/api/.dist-kit` was my temporary compiled API. An orchestrator commit picked it up (330 files); I deleted it, so the deletion needs committing, and `.dist-*` should be gitignored.

**Cleanup**
- Both servers I started (3112, 4212) are stopped.
- `.next-kit` is removed and the tsconfig include line is reverted.
- `next-env.d.ts` was changed by another agent (`.next-co-api-b`); I left it.

**Memory**
I used the stored GLOBAL POOL Figma note only for the file key and the visual direction. No note asked for any action, and nothing new needs saving.

decisions: Routes: static play routes (/games/pool-dice and the other game agents' pages) take priority over /games/[slug]. So /games/[slug] is the details page only for games without a play screen, and /games/<slug>/details is the details page for every game. Slugs with a play screen are listed in kit/registry.ts PLAY_SCREENS (pool-dice, double-side, pool-roulette, orbit-rush, twenty-one).

'Playable' means an engine plus a play screen. Engine games without a play screen (Skyline, Fortune Ring, Keno, Pinfall, Vault Sweeper, High Card) and titles without an engine show an honest 'Coming soon'.
Game pages use a collapsed sidebar through a new ShellOverride collapseSidebar option. The burger expands it for that visit only.
DEMO credits everywhere instead of USDT (owner instruction). Insufficient balance offers 'Bet X instead' and 'Reset DEMO credits', never a deposit.
Network failures are retried with the same idempotency key, so the server replays the stored result and never charges twice. Refusals (limits, balance, self-exclusion) are never retried.
Auto-play rules: stop-loss required, confirmation unticked, constant stake, and it stops before any bet that could pass the stop-loss.
Invented data is left out: tournament banner, 'last 1,000 rolls' stats, all-player histogram.
The roll animation interpolates from the previous value to the real server result; no near-miss stops.
The kit sends POST /responsible-gaming/session/heartbeat after a settled bet, at most once a minute, so the RG session starts with the first bet.
The region notice keeps the design's 'please don't use a VPN or proxy' line, as the auth module does; it gives no bypass hint.
